data.body: [P2] Preserve the existing public record shape. Adding an eighth component breaks recompilation of Java 21+ consumers using seven-component `InvocationInfo` record patterns. The compatibility test explicitly expects that failure; retained constructors do not prevent it. The project still builds as `2.3.1-SNAPSHOT`, so documenting an intended major-release boundary does not preserve compatibility on the current line. Keep the seven-component record and carry the header through separate immutable metadata with backward-compatible hook/extractor overloads, then require the legacy pattern to compile successfully.
